brand.name: Wathiq
brand.promise: Confident decisions on every document — with the evidence attached.

roleDescriptions.ops_officer: Creates cases, uploads documents and tracks their progress.
roleDescriptions.reviewer: Works the review queue: approve, correct or reject doubtful fields.
roleDescriptions.supervisor: Handles escalations and SLA breaches, and sees the team dashboards.
roleDescriptions.admin: Manages document types, prompts, rules, users and integrations.
roleDescriptions.auditor: Read-only access to every case and the full audit trail.

login.trust1: Every extracted value carries its confidence and its source region.
login.trust2: Humans review only what the system is genuinely unsure about.

pipelineProgress.title: Pipeline
pipelineProgress.waitingToStart: Waiting for the pipeline to start.
pipelineProgress.streamDropped: The live stream dropped. The case keeps processing on the server — open it to see the final state.
pipelineProgress.parked: The pipeline paused at the review gate and is waiting for a reviewer. Its checkpoint resumes from this exact point after a decision.
pipelineProgress.noFrames: The stream closed without progress frames. Open the case to see its current state.
